subject: Using a date as colour fails

messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: Using a date as colour fails
parts:
Hi everyone,

I don't know whether using a date (POSIXct) in a colour mapping is
supposed to be invalid but it currently fails.

a = read.table(textConnection("date, x, y
2008-11-25 11:21:50, 10.2516422, -11.5090033
2008-11-25 11:22:05, 11.1053127, -10.8087639
2008-11-25 11:22:20, 11.6594761, -10.0120475
2008-11-25 11:22:36, 13.2709195, -7.9856268
2008-11-25 11:22:51, 14.0127093, -6.5551218
2008-11-25 11:23:06, 14.7598268, -5.1593914
2008-11-25 11:23:22, 14.6802017, -4.1750486
2008-11-25 11:23:38, 15.2590637, -2.3780065
2008-11-25 11:23:53, 15.5089719, -0.5245896
2008-11-25 11:24:08, 15.5101305, 1.3263083
2008-11-25 11:24:23, 15.1716798, 3.3031301
2008-11-25 11:24:38, 14.9050077, 4.5791333
"), header=TRUE, sep=",")
closeAllConnections()

a$date = as.POSIXct(a$date)
library("ggplot2")

ggplot(a) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y))
# when date is mapped to x or y, ggplot deals with it beautifully
ggplot(a) + geom_point(aes(x=date, y=y))

# mapping to colour of continuous variables or factors works well
ggplot(a) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, colour=x))
ggplot(a) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, colour=factor(x)))
# mapping date to colour outputs very different colours and no scale...
ggplot(a) + geom_point(aes(x=x, y=y, colour=date))
# http://dl.getdropbox.com/u/1047321/Picture%201.png

JiHO
